purpose: Before inventing another event trigger, test whether the already outcome-blind M10W14 NEITHER regime buckets themselves contain stable 240-minute directional opportunity across train/validation/test. This is exploratory research on fixed buckets, not support for existing families.

sampling.per_bucket_non_overlap: For each exact regime bucket independently, take the first eligible NEITHER M15 decision, then do not take another observation for that same bucket until at least 240 minutes later.
sampling.entry_time: exact M1 timestamp equal to M15 decision_time

selection_rule_frozen_before_run.stable_opportunity: All density, train, validation, test and cost-robustness conditions pass for the same exact bucket and direction.

multiple_bucket_policy: Evaluate every pre-existing exact M10W14 regime bucket under the same frozen rule. Do not create new cut points or combine adjacent buckets after outcomes. Passing buckets remain research-exposed hypotheses and require a later preregistered event-entry design plus fresh prospective validation.

interpretation.failure_meaning: If no exact NEITHER regime bucket shows stable directionality, the coarse EMA/MACD/ATR regime space itself is not supplying a robust blind-spot edge and future research should add genuinely new information rather than tune current thresholds.
interpretation.success_meaning: If one or more exact buckets pass across all frozen splits and costs, later work may design a causal event trigger inside that bucket, frozen before outcome testing.
